episodes.title: Revenge
episodes.summary: Running drugs is a family affair for Etta Tiger Jonze, but when the family business is threatened, she's thrust into a life she never expected.

episodes.title: Orphans
episodes.summary: Etta must find a way to pay off a black-market surgeon who is threatening to turn her in, as the Rojas siblings struggle with their conflicting agendas.

episodes.title: American Immigrant
episodes.summary: Etta tracks down her estranged Aunt Carmen and makes a shocking discovery; suspecting she's alive, Kincaid sets out to find Etta; Mateo and Samuel navigate operational challenges.

episodes.title: Can't Hardly Carlito
episodes.summary: Etta crosses paths with a woman connected to one of "the twelve" and schemes to lure the killer into her orbit; Elias is forced to confront a dangerous rival.

episodes.title: Fault Lines
episodes.summary: Etta tracks down one of her family's killers and uncovers the Rojas cartel's base of operations; Caroline navigates local corruption while Mateo and Samuel are backed into a corner by a ruthless rival.

episodes.title: Original Sin
episodes.summary: Etta makes a discovery about her employer, Lena, and finds herself in a fight for her life; in the past, Carmen and Leah become estranged, and Dan and Leah get into drug running.

episodes.title: Hammer Drop
episodes.summary: Etta is torn between serving her revenge agenda and helping a friend; the Rojas brothers are presented with a dangerous and lucrative business venture.

episodes.title: Heart Matters
episodes.summary: As Etta plans her next strike against the men who killed her family, a tragic event hits close to home; Mateo and Samuel find themselves in Federov's deadly crosshairs.

episodes.title: Aperture
episodes.summary: Etta finds a balance between her revenge mission and her newly forged chosen family until the Rojases strike again; Mateo initiates an operation to neutralize Federov; Samuel is forced to make a devastating choice.
